texts.sample: Four or five months in, the day the first piece of feedback arrived was an ordinary one. I opened the dashboard and saw that someone had actually finished the whole thing. It was better than I expected. The parts I assumed nobody would bother filling in, they filled in, with far more honesty than the sample text I had written. That was when it landed on me.

I read it three times standing at the kitchen counter, coffee going cold. Then I closed the laptop and walked around the block, because I did not know where to put it. All those months of guessing in the dark, and here was one person saying: it reached me. That was enough to keep going.
